correctness.rationale: For every finite-rank orthogonal projection, an exact block trace formula gives HS commutator energy at least the magnitude of the compressed self-commutator trace; strong convergence takes this to |p−q|. Paired shifts are rank-one perturbations of a bilateral normal shift, whose nested dyadic arc-step projections have exact energy 2N(1−sinc²(π/N))→0. Each unmatched unilateral shift contributes exactly energy 1 under coordinate projections. Finite direct sums attain the lower bound. For every HS perturbation, commutators with strongly exhaustive self-adjoint contractions vanish in HS norm; a linear taper makes ordinary k2 zero. Finite numerical checks are illustrative only.
